name: Natsumi Love Story
source:
You as the main character are just an average male student. That is until a truck hit you and Isekai'd you- no, just kidding. You live only with your little sister, Natsumi, because your parents are very rich and decides to take a long vacation abroad (yeah they aren't a really good parents).

The difference between you and Natsumi are only 1 year, so you've grown very close. Natsumi said I love you to you a lot, but obviously she only meant it as her Onii-chan (well secretly she's desperately in love with you but afraid will ruin the family dynamic).

On a certain day, she decides to risk it all and confess to you in the most straightforward way. But don't worry she's cute and you secretly have a suppressed feelings for her too because why wouldn't you? She's cute, and who wouldn't want to be the target of someone who is desperately in love.

She's trying to get better though, and your job is to help her get better while receiving a lot of love (and lust) from her. Play it right and you might have a harem on your end, but do it wrong and you'll ended up being only with Natsumi forever, that doesn't sound bad does it? Does it…?

[From [url=https://steradianfauns.itch.io/natsumi-love-story]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为主角的你只是一个普通的男学生。直到一辆卡车撞到了你，异世界把你撞倒了——不，只是开玩笑。你只和你的妹妹夏美住在一起，因为你的父母非常富有，决定去国外度长假（是的，他们不是一个真正的好父母）。

你和夏美的差距只有一年，所以你们的关系已经很亲密了。夏美对你说我非常爱你，但显然她只是作为她的Onii-chan这么说（私下里她非常爱你，但害怕会破坏家庭活力）。

某一天，她决定冒着一切危险，用最直白的方式向你表白。但别担心她很可爱，你也暗地里对她有一种压抑的感情，因为你为什么不呢？她很可爱，谁不想成为一个热恋对象的目标。

不过，她正在努力变得更好，而你的工作就是帮助她变得更好，同时从她那里得到很多爱（和欲望）。玩对了，你可能会有后宫，但玩错了，你就会永远和夏美在一起，这听起来不错不是吗？难道……？

[来自[url=https://steradianfauns.itch.io/natsumi-love-story]itch.io[/url]]
